host.adapter: ANGLE (Microsoft, Microsoft Basic Render Driver (0x0000008C) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-10.0.20348.5756)

scope.admission_latency: Actual application command admission to the next completed physical step. Input is tick-addressed; this is NOT wall-clock device/input-delivery latency.
scope.draw_delivery: Main-thread frame_post_draw delivery, NOT a GPU fence or physical scanout.
scope.material_age: Original native material generation to matching inline Main render-serial notification only. Separate notifications are deferred to Main and have no upload-specific draw identity; those material-age joins remain unavailable.
scope.physical_age: Age of the latest completed physical step when draw callback is delivered. This is NOT proof that that pose was displayed.
scope.native_duration: Native-reported elapsed tick duration from the first healthy packet per consumed sample; may include scheduling/preemption.
scope.overlap: Observed interval overlap is descriptive. It does NOT by itself assign a driver, hardware or scheduler root cause.
scope.validation: Supplementary timing only; original V3 source/native/terrain/callback/body/input/Water/current-GPU gates must independently pass.

physical_outcome_parity.disposition: Same-source equal-step body and admitted-move outcomes agree; cross-source outcomes are disclosed, not assumed.
physical_outcome_parity.scope: Different-source speed deltas are whole-source comparisons. Identical initial workload alone does not establish identical physical outcomes. Repeated input admission counts remain explicit and can differ with cadence.

cohort.scope: One actual repaired executable, Safe/Separate/Separate/Safe. All source/runtime, hardware, workload and equal-step physical outcomes remain matched. This isolates render ownership within that executable; it does not attribute stock/custom differences to one patch or qualify physical NVIDIA hardware.

scope: Read-only replay of original Windows/ANGLE execution. Every frozen renderer-derived V3 native, terrain, callback, Water, body, input and GPU predicate is retained. Actual source/runtime/driver, submitted pose/geometry/Follow/CPU and raw font/startup/180-admission histories are revalidated. Original red predecessor and all negative controls are unchanged. No new Godot execution, physical NVIDIA acceptance or default promotion.
